ablation: Uniform static factor priors. Secondary controls remove covariance off-diagonals or ATR admission hurdle while preserving learned factors.
allocation: Conviction-weighted risk budgets from 63-day exponentially weighted covariance shrunk 50% to single-factor target. Normalize then cap each name at 25% without redistribution. Scale down to 40% annualized volatility times breadth/drawdown regime.
cash_rule: Unfilled caps, weak signal and missing history remain cash. No leverage or minimum gross.
contamination_notes: Reference contains many tuned versions and unverified trial Sharpes. 2016-2022 reused development; 2023-2024 spent; 2025+ diagnostic; live untouched.
cost_hypothesis: Weekly updates and ATR hurdle reduce marginal expensive entries. Hurdle is a scale proxy, not calibrated expected P&L; official stats decide net economics.

factor_definitions.quality: 63-day directional path efficiency minus downside semideviation / volatility

failure_mode: Noisy IC, redundant factors, delayed exits or unnecessary complexity; controls preserve apparent edge.
falsifier: Rotate learned factor-weight assignments by one factor, preserving their distribution and all other machinery.
nearest_incumbent: V10 / factor balance / VIPER-HELIOS engineering library. Frontier-F failed expert/cash allocator remains frozen.
novelty_note: Engineering refinement of an occupied factor lineage; no new raw information or independent-alpha claim.
portfolio_role: Factor-family alternative requiring future incumbent/residual evidence.
primitive: Sponsor OHLCV and historical is_liquid only.
rebalance: Monday targets; eligibility exits remain closed until next Monday. Intraweek gross can only fall with risk ceiling. No recursive state outside weekly interval.
scope: Focused translation of user-supplied VIPER-HELIOS v22 engineering primitives, not an independent-alpha discovery campaign.
selection: Positive factor score and close above 126-day mean; vol-scaled conviction exceeds round-trip ATR proxy; top six using sorted-label ties.
selection_objective: Minimum research/dev Sharpe at 4/8/12 percent ATR; no retuning after observation.
source_notes: Fresh implementation; no imported performance claims or tuned v22 parameters.
stop_rule: Freeze if ANY matched comparator matches/beats central parent; kill weak if all three bases below 1.0. No automatic promotion or grid rescue.
thesis: Conservative factor-skill learning on completed nonoverlapping horizons improves a fixed factor book after costs; covariance risk budgeting and ATR-aware admission retain usable exposure.
timing: Completed bar t generates target t; official evaluator applies execution lag once. Labels end by t-1; no negative shifts or external loaders inside strategy.
transform: Centered ranks; residualize flow/quality/low-risk against momentum. Pair source-day ranks with completed 5/21-day returns. Separate nonoverlapping calendar phase per horizon. Rolling IC mean, uncertainty and count shrink toward uniform priors. Shift learned coefficients one additional day.
universe: Historical is_liquid == 1; positive finite OHLCV; 126 consecutive valid closing returns before admission. Missing liquidity disallows holdings.
